$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the multi-target build. Edit this, then run `npm run build`. Bump `version` once per PR — installs are versioned snapshots, and `claude plugin update` no-ops unless the version moved; while iterating within a PR, uninstall/reinstall to refresh a local install to regenerate .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, .agents/plugins/marketplace.json, plugins/*, and manifest.json. CI (`npm test`) fails if the generated files drift. A plugin composes with other plugins two ways: `dependencies` is a build-time CLOSURE — the build bundles every dependency's skills+hooks+agents into the self-contained plugins/<name>/ dir that BOTH harnesses install (no native, Claude-only resolution, so Claude Code and Codex install identically). `requires` is a documented-only dependency — NOT bundled and NOT auto-installed; the user installs it themselves. Use `requires` when a plugin builds on another but shouldn't ship a copy of it.

marketplace.name: lightcone-research
marketplace.description: Agent skills for Lightcone Research — ASTRA, lightcone-cli project workflows, and scientific paper reproduction.

plugins.name: astra
plugins.description: Reference for the ASTRA specification (astra.yaml): top-level structure, sub-analyses, inputs/outputs, decisions and options, prior insights and findings, evidence and quote verification, and composition mechanics. Invoke when reading, writing, validating, or debugging an astra.yaml spec, or when the user asks about ASTRA schema or sub-analysis composition. Ships hooks that validate astra.yaml on save and remind agents to load the skill when they read an ASTRA file.

plugins.name: lightcone
plugins.description: Core workflow for a Lightcone / ASTRA analysis with the lightcone-cli (lc) toolchain: `new` scopes a new analysis from a research question, `report` authors the MyST report that references astra.yaml elements by path, `cli` carries the lc execution reference (spec–code invariant, status interpretation, failure diagnosis), and `feedback` files bug reports. Ships the lc-extractor subagent for literature extraction. Bundles the astra reference — and with it the astra hooks (session primer, validate-on-save, activate-on-read) — so this one plugin is all you need for interactive work inside an lc / ASTRA project.

plugins.name: reproduction
plugins.description: Scientific paper replication workflows: assess candidate papers for reproducibility (`assess-reproducibility`), carry out a complete independently verified replication (`reproduce`), and compare reproduced figures, tables, and values with the originals (`figure-comparison`). Bundles the ASTRA reference and validation hooks, so this plugin is self-contained for reproduction work.

plugins.name: lightcone-experimental
plugins.description: Opt-in, experimental skills for advanced Lightcone workflows — under active development, expect rough edges. Includes staged paper reproduction (`from-paper`), code import (`from-code`), literature substrate extraction (`paper-extraction`), and autonomous iteration (`ralph`). Requires the `lightcone` and `reproduction` plugins (install both first) because these workflows build on the core lc project workflow and the reproduction review skills, but do not bundle either plugin.
